name: Pilot Bridge
objective: Reconcile pilot/reference before-after KPI notes and produce four-cell descriptive difference-in-differences worksheets.

nearest.name: Discovery Ledger
nearest.description: Reconcile informal experiment summaries with real local MiniLM hypothesis inference. Review a predefined complete register and p-values, block incomplete families, compare BH/Holm adjustments with raw thresholds and export complete JSON/CSV/register CSV/Markdown without uploads.

nearest.name: Return Mosaic
nearest.description: Reconcile informal activity logs with real local MiniLM event inference. Review identities and UTC times, compare fully observed return-window cohorts against immature-inclusive rates, and export complete JSON/CSV/account worksheets/Markdown without uploads or outreach.

nearest.name: Evidence Loom
nearest.description: Match rough experiment summaries with real local MiniLM outcome inference. Review signed effects, standard errors and independent studies; compare precision-weighted synthesis with simple averages, inspect heterogeneity and leave-one-out results, and export complete JSON/CSV/Markdown without uploads.

nearest.name: Mix Lantern
nearest.description: Reconcile rough cohort notes with real local MiniLM segment inference. Review A/B counts, compare rates at a supplied target audience mix against pooled totals, stress-test mix sensitivity and break-even weights, then export complete JSON/CSV/Markdown without uploads or launch decisions.

nearest.name: Closure Horizon
nearest.description: Read follow-up notes with real local MiniLM workstream and outcome inference. Verify completion versus right censoring, review exact risk sets and completion curves against a naive count, then export complete JSON/CSV/Markdown follow-up worksheets without uploads.

distinction: Not survival, retention, meta-analysis, multiple testing or target-mix standardization: four comparable aggregate cells per metric; net change vs pilot-only delta, whole-metric blocking, explicit descriptive goals and causal-assumption follow-up checklist.
